candidates.title: ActivePool.flashLoan leaves any collateral balance above systemCollShares permanently stuck
candidates.description: After the ERC3156 flashloan repayment, the invariant checks only require balance/shares >= systemCollShares (not equality), so any collateral force-sent to ActivePool above systemCollShares is unrecoverable (sweepToken forbids collateral). Acknowledged in-code as inherited-from-LUSD behavior; noted as a low-severity stuck-funds/accounting observation.

candidates.title: ActivePool TWAP auto-disables on first setValueAndUpdate revert (try/catch swallows failure)
candidates.description: increase/decreaseSystemDebt wrap setValueAndUpdate in try/catch and permanently set twapDisabled=true on any revert. A transient failure (or an induced one) permanently disables the TWAP observer used by redemption fee logic. Documented as an intentional liveness>accuracy tradeoff (@audit annotations in source); flagged as a latent governance/observer-integrity risk.
